comment:
* This cache creates one file per SSL session using "host.port" for * the file name. Files are created or replaced when session data is put * in the cache (see {@link #putSessionData}). Files are read on * cache hits, but not on cache misses. * *

When the number of session files exceeds MAX_SIZE, we delete the * least-recently-used file. We don't current persist the last access time, * so the ordering actually ends up being least-recently-modified in some * cases and even just "not accessed in this process" if the filesystem * doesn't track last modified times.

variables.name: directory
variables.comment: Directory to store session files in.

variables.name: accessOrder
variables.comment: * Map of name -> File. Keeps track of the order files were accessed in.

variables.name: size
variables.comment: The number of files on disk.

variables.name: initialFiles
variables.comment:
* The initial set of files. We use this to defer adding information
         * about all files to accessOrder until necessary.
